entities.name: Saints Faith, Hope, Charity and Their Mother Sophia Orthodox church in Almaty
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Sophia Cathedral, dedicated to the martyrs Vera, Nadezhda, Lyubov and their mother Sophia of Rome, is the cathedral of the Astany and Almaty diocese, located in the city of Almaty, Kazakhstan.
